title: The Voices Beneath the Water · Episode 18: The Test That Helps
description: Jon offers an overconfident demonstration at the temporary class. A teacher helps him turn a confusing exercise into a useful test of how people learn: simple physical models, translated labels, and a short illustrated story with a bear's paw and a wolf. His awkward demonstration earns a laugh; he learns to ask what the learners need rather than show what he knows.
